name: relay_hysteria_v1
summary: The 'hysteria_v1' relay kind — a legacy Hysteria v1 outbound with a single auth payload (string|base64), udp|wechat-video|faketcp transport obfuscation, explicit up/down bandwidth in Mbps, and optional SNI/ALPN; INLINE_SETTINGS_BACKED, in-process Rust backend, TCP only. Distinct from the active Hysteria2 kind.

Define the RelayKindHysteriaV1 constant alongside the other RelayKind* constants. The constant must equal the wire string.
Add a RelayKindDescriptor row to RelayKindDescriptors with kindId = RelayKindHysteriaV1 and the capability tuple tcp=true, udp=false, reusable=false, supportsOutboundBindIp=false.

Mirror the Kotlin descriptor row in RELAY_TRANSPORT_REGISTRATIONS with matching capability fields (tcp=true, udp=false, reusable=false, supports_outbound_bind_ip=false) and a build_hysteria_v1 backend builder.
